mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the average 20-day return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand, which drives corporate earnings growth and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0, following a prior uptick, signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reflects weakening economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 3.5% combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate signals entrenched inflationary expectations, which trigger forward-looking equity risk premiums and suppress S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS >= 5.0% fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) at a quarterly rate above 2.5% signals robust economic growth that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in less than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5%, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 50k in a month, following a prior trend of above-100k growth, signals labor market softening that reduces wage pressures and lowers inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to pivot toward easing and boosting equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 50.0, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between rising industrial production (INDPRO) and falling residential construction (HOUST) signals a supply-side imbalance where manufacturing is expanding but housing is contracting, reflecting sector-specific weakness that undermines confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO > 102.0 and HOUST < 1350.0 fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
